items.title: Seattle Times, Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft over AI training

items.title: AI hiring boom could turn into a surprise tailwind for software: Bernstein
items.summary: Investing.com -- Artificial intelligence could prove a surprise tailwind for software companies if productivity gains spur businesses to hire more workers rather than cut headcount, Bernstein analysts said, challenging one of the sector’s key bearish narratives.
